gam.interpretation: Absolute route permeability is already mostly determined by its measured initial value; compare against persistence. Construction material is 0.08 synthetic units per committed branch in this campaign, so count and material are coupled responses, not independent diversity axes. Conditional prediction uses the recorded world's preconstruction route measurement; confirmation proposal forecasts were based on the three fitting layouts instead.
